title: Our own fine-tunes are losing our own arena
claim: CSOAI's own specialist models (council-safe, council-oowm) rank BELOW stock open models on our own 24x7 arena. We publish this because measurement is the product, not our win-rate.
findings: Best Council specialist rank: 1098.6 — below 6 of 6 stock models
implication: The instrument measures honestly. A measurer publishing a result that embarrasses it is what pulls outsiders in.
